artifacts.summary: Package the app so other households can self-serve their own fully isolated instance — own Sheet, own Firebase project, own deployed app. Revised after review: captain will host a one-time provisioning helper (creates the new project + copies a blank Sheet template) but no shared backend or credential the captain runs may ever read/write another household's live data. Architecture reviewed and confirmed against the current codebase; see docs/plans/023-product-packaging-architecture.md.
